description: This file contains a single utility function `freeze` that takes a Keras model and sets all of its layers to non-trainable by setting `layer.trainable = False`. It is used to freeze the weights of a model, typically for transfer learning scenarios.

methods.name: freeze(model)
methods.description: Set all layers in a Keras model to non-trainable by setting their trainable attribute to False. Modifies the model in-place and returns it for chaining.
